# Plugins Directory
#
# Drop a .py file here to register a compaction tool automatically.
# The dashboard picks up any class that extends PreCompactor or PostCompactor.
#
# Quick start:
#   uv run python -m compaction scaffold pre "MyTool" my-package
#   # edit the generated file, fill in the TODOs
#   uv run python app.py
#
# See pre_openprovence.py and post_headroom.py for working examples.
